name: std::chrono::time_point<Clock,Duration>::time_since_epoch
intro: Returns a duration representing the amount of time between *this and the clock's epoch.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The amount of time between this time_point and the clock's epoch.

examples.output:
epoch: Thu Jan  1 00:00:00 1970
today: Fri Jun 30 10:44:11 2017
hours since epoch: 416338
yesterday, hours since epoch: 416314

summary: Returns a duration representing the amount of time between *this and the clock's epoch.
